name: ORCA Computing
description: ORCA Computing is a London-based quantum computing company building photonic quantum computers that operate at room temperature using telecom-standard single photons stored in quantum memories. Spun out of the University of Oxford, ORCA has delivered systems to the UK Ministry of Defence and the National Quantum Computing Centre, and leads the Quantum Data Centre of the Future consortium.

products.description: Room-temperature photonic quantum computers using telecom-wavelength single photons and quantum memories

news.title: ORCA Computing Delivers First Photonic Quantum Computing System to UK's National Quantum Computing Centre
news.excerpt: ORCA Computing has delivered and installed the UK's first public-sector photonic quantum computing system at the National Quantum Computing Centre (NQCC), fulfilling a key commitment under the UK's Quantum Computing Testbeds program.
